en.joke: The most thrilling part of my day is deciding whether to click 'Accept All Cookies' or 'Manage Preferences' and then still accepting all cookies.
en.explanation: It's funny because it subverts the expectation of excitement with a mundane, relatable, and slightly self-deprecating observation about digital fatigue.

people.name: Albert Shiryaev
people.extract: Albert Nikolayevich Shiryaev is a Soviet and Russian mathematician. He is known for his work in probability theory, statistics and financial mathematics.
highlights: Known for work in probability theory.
Also known for statistics and financial mathematics.

people.name: Mike Green (ice hockey, born 1985)
people.extract: Michael David Green is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman who played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Washington Capitals, Detroit Red Wings and Edmonton Oilers.
highlights: Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman.
Played in the National Hockey League (NHL).
Played for Capitals, Red Wings, and Oilers.
